metadata.title: AI Coding Agents State - Sources
metadata.description: Official documentation and implementation references for session lifecycle, resume, checkpointing, context forking, task models, background execution, and durable triggers

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Documentation
official_documentation.relevance: Primary runtime documentation for Claude Code operational behavior

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Manage Sessions
official_documentation.relevance: Authoritative source for --continue/--resume/--from-pr, the /resume picker, session naming and default names, session-picker scoping and widen keys (Ctrl+W/Ctrl+A/Ctrl+B), /branch and --fork-session semantics, transcript storage path and cleanupPeriodDays retention

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Checkpointing
official_documentation.relevance: Authoritative source for /rewind, Esc-Esc entry, per-prompt checkpoint creation, restore modes (code/conversation/both), Summarize from here / Summarize up to here, the bash-command tracking limitation, and rewind-past-/clear- behavior (v2.1.191+)

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Create Custom Subagents
official_documentation.relevance: Authoritative source for fork-vs-named-subagent startup modes, explicit fork-type selection, CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT across interactive, claude -p, and Agent SDK surfaces, current /subtask and historical or agent-view-dependent /fork behavior, version gates, no-nested-forks rule, isolation: worktree option, and prompt-cache economics; re-verified 2026-09-07

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Agent View Documentation
official_documentation.relevance: Agent-view panel for monitoring and resuming background agents; claude agents / claude attach / claude stop / claude respawn / claude rm; disableAgentView setting; daemon roster.json, jobs/<id>/state.json, and worktree.bgIsolation; CI use via claude agents --json

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Agent View Blog Post
official_documentation.relevance: Announcement and deep dive on agent-view: background session state paths, daemon architecture, awaySummary behavior, and CI integration via claude agents --json

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Settings Reference
official_documentation.relevance: Confirms exact settings.json keys and defaults relevant to session lifecycle: disableAgentView, cleanupPeriodDays (default 30 days, minimum 1), awaySummaryEnabled (default true)

official_documentation.name: Claude Code Slash Commands
official_documentation.relevance: Official command and prompt-surface documentation relevant to task launch, task discovery, and interactive coordination flows

implementation_references.name: Claude Code GitHub Repository
implementation_references.relevance: Closed-source product page and issue tracker for Claude Code; not the implementation source — use code.claude.com/docs/en for authoritative behavior docs

implementation_references.name: Anthropic: Claude Code Best Practices
implementation_references.relevance: Broader operational patterns for stable Claude Code usage and recovery

cross_runtime_references.name: Codex CLI Developer Commands Reference
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Current official reference (redirect target of developers.openai.com/codex/cli/reference) for codex resume/--last/--all, codex fork, and codex cloud/cloud-tasks (list/exec/apply) command syntax; re-verified 2026-07-11. Does not publicly document SQLite storage internals — those remain sourced from the pinned commit below

cross_runtime_references.name: Chris Hayduk — Using Codex Goals Effectively
cross_runtime_references.relevance: First-party (OpenAI) guidance on Codex /goal command: quantitative-goal pattern, checklist-as-score trick, tight feedback loops, and 3-file journaling for multi-day runs. Source for the 'Goal-Mode Loops' section.

cross_runtime_references.name: Jarrod Watts — You Need More Than a Ralph Loop
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Critique of bare goal-mode/ralph loops. Source for the 'When bare goal-mode is not enough' subsection: ambiguity bottleneck, single-context-window bottleneck, cross-context memory bottleneck, and pointers to orchestrator+reviewer triad and Watts 4-file journaling. Companion github skill: https://github.com/jarrodwatts/long-running-agent-skill

cross_runtime_references.name: Anthropic: Introducing Routines in Claude Code
cross_runtime_references.relevance: First-party announcement of Routines per-plan run caps, overage billing, and the one-off-run exemption. Caps change; read current values from the docs page.

cross_runtime_references.name: Claude Code Routines Docs
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Current canonical Routines reference: availability status, per-plan caps, and the one-off-run exemption. Look up live values here.

cross_runtime_references.name: Claude Code Changelog — v2.1.186 (background permission-prompt routing)
cross_runtime_references.relevance: First-party source that background subagent permission prompts surface into the parent/lead session (2026-06-22) instead of silently auto-denying. Corrects an earlier auto-deny-only description of background-subagent behavior. Source for Background-Subagent Task Semantics.

cross_runtime_references.name: Claude Code Workflows Documentation
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Code-mode orchestration surface: loop and fan-out primitives absent from Codex CLI

cross_runtime_references.name: Codex CLI Multi-Agent v2 vs Claude Dynamic Workflows
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Third-party runtime asymmetry reference (dated): TOML roles and depth/thread settings. Superseded details: `max_threads` is now `agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session`, and the experimental `spawn_agents_on_csv` tool it describes was removed.
